opening-join.text: you have built important skills. Now you have to decide what you are actually going to do with them.
When thinking about how AI will change careers, it is easy to worry that entire professions will disappear.

teacher-graft.text: applies to a teacher. AI excels at drafting lesson plans or creating practice activities.
But humans still own the core responsibilities, knowing the individual student,
building motivation, adapting a lesson in the moment.

close.text: and where human judgment remains critical,
you know how to be smarter than the tool.
Keep learning. Keep building. Make your move.
